stories.h: US-Canada trade war puts North America's core economic pact at risk
stories.w: President Trump said he was considering leaving the USMCA after negotiations collapsed, raising the stakes for two economies linked by energy, agriculture and the world's largest bilateral goods market.

stories.h: Washington pledges no unilateral anti-drug action inside Latin American allies
stories.w: Secretary of State Marco Rubio made the commitment in Lima while the United States continues deadly strikes on alleged drug boats, clarifying a consequential boundary in its expanding regional security campaign.

stories.h: Russian strikes kill eight as Putin warns Europe against deploying troops
stories.w: The attacks wounded dozens and hit homes across several Ukrainian regions while the Russian president said a European deployment would mean war with Russia, escalating both military and diplomatic risk.

stories.h: Ukrainian troops embed with the US Army to transfer drone-war lessons
stories.w: About a dozen Ukrainian personnel advised American exercises in Germany as the US Army debates how to restructure ground forces around technology now central to modern battlefields.

stories.h: Congo's record Ebola outbreak spreads west to a seventh province
stories.w: A confirmed case in South-Ubangi marks a major geographic jump from the eastern epicentre; national authorities reported more than 7,000 cases and nearly 3,400 deaths as response teams face conflict and displacement.

stories.h: Two Nigerians killed in South Africa as anti-migrant tensions deepen
stories.w: Nigeria says one victim died after police interrogation and another at home, adding pressure to a dispute that has already halted parliamentary visits and forced thousands of migrants to leave.

stories.h: BRICS condemns unilateral sanctions while wars test the expanded bloc
stories.w: Leaders of a group representing about half the world's population challenged Western-led pressure tools and voiced concern over Middle East attacks, even as members remained divided over Ukraine and Iran.

stories.h: Modi and Xi seek a cautious reset after years of border tension
stories.w: The leaders pledged wider exchanges and work toward a boundary settlement during Xi's first visit to India since 2019, a potentially durable shift between Asia's two largest countries.

stories.h: Tasmania proposes halving face-to-face service hours in remote communities
stories.w: Five regional centres could lose up to half their in-person hours, testing whether a government shift toward digital delivery can avoid excluding older residents and island communities with unreliable access.

stories.h: Floating wetland cuts wastewater-lagoon emissions by about 30%
stories.w: A two-year full-scale trial found large reductions in carbon dioxide and methane using a retrofit of native plants, offering a low-infrastructure climate option now moving to broader tests.
